title: Does an OmO mass-ultrawork swarm beat one agent on a hard task?
hypothesis: On three hard multi-file tasks, a bounded OmO swarm accepts more tasks than the best single-agent arm, and the extra cost per accepted task stays under 3x.
human_gate: Frank sets the dollar cap for each swarm run before it starts.

runs_on.why: A swarm of many agents is too heavy for the laptop and must be isolated.

arms.model: mixed per OmO graph, restricted to the allowlist

success_rule: Swarm accepts at least one more task than the baseline and total cost per accepted task is under 3x the baseline.
kill: Hard stop at $4 total and at 20 minutes per run. A swarm that spawns outside the model allowlist ends the run and the experiment.

next_gate.receipt: lab/results/EXP-003.md with run logs and cost

decision_it_feeds: Whether swarms are a default lane, an on-demand lane, or not worth the spend.
